title.zh: 彭博：DeepSeek完成第二轮1000亿元融资，腾讯、宁德时代出资最多
title.en: 彭博：DeepSeek完成第二轮1000亿元融资，腾讯、宁德时代出资最多

current_state.zh: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.
current_state.en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.
